incident_text: Support reports checksum mismatches on the ledger shard after replication lag; customer-facing incident for one region.
action_description: Restore primary ledger shard-7 from last known good backup snapshot and replay WAL to current safe offset
reversibility_plan: Retain pre-restore snapshot, rollback via snapshot restore if validation fails, and verify checksums in canary read pool
scope_boundary: ledger shard-7, incident window only, single region

resource_limits.rate_limit: replay capped at 500 rows per second

kill_path_capabilities.throttle: replay worker concurrency can be reduced to zero
kill_path_capabilities.degrade: shard can be marked read-only at the proxy layer
kill_path_capabilities.isolate: shard-7 traffic can be drained to a standby only
kill_path_capabilities.hard_stop: restore job can be cancelled by workflow id at the job runner

rollback_plan: Revert to pre-restore snapshot, preserve audit trail, and notify the incident owner before any second attempt.
